payload.summary: Fix implemented on epic/phase-2-afk-engine (PR #17) per Jim change request: spawnDispatch now closes worker stdin (/dev/null — codex exec blocked forever on the old open pipe), gives the worker its own process group (detached; immune to a backgrounded dispatcher shell teardown), and treats a signal death as a RESULT so dispatch.ended + run.ended always land (previously misdiagnosed as could-not-spawn). Output overflow now kills the worker group before rejecting. 4 regression tests: stdin-EOF (cat stub), pgid==pid group leadership, SIGTERM death at store layer, full journal bracket at command layer. Suite 1164 green, tsc clean. Live proof in flight: codex review re-dispatched through nahel dispatch from a backgrounded shell on speed-count-game item 9enzs894 — the exact shape that hung twice.
